abstract: Comprehensive PocketBase development best practices and performance optimization guide. Contains 64 rules across 9 categories, prioritized by impact from critical (collection design, API rules, authentication) to incremental (production deployment). Includes server-side extending rules for Go and JavaScript (JSVM). Updated for PocketBase v0.40.0 and JS SDK v0.28.0: Go 1.27 / encoding/json/v2 upgrade cautions, non-zero exit code propagation, superuser IP/CIDR whitelisting (v0.38), realtime 30min absolute connection timeout, OAuth2 pre-linking hijack fix (run >=0.38.2), log truncation limits and pb.logs.truncate(), SQL console positioning, lock-free backups. Each rule includes detailed explanations, incorrect vs. correct code examples, and specific guidance to help AI agents generate better PocketBase code.
